name: mochi
description: A desktop companion that lives on your screen. Mochi chats through its own panel, watches pages and feeds for you, plans its own day around your schedule, remembers your time together, and taps you on the shoulder only when something actually changed.
author: kirocrew
highlights: A pet window that floats on your desktop — transparent, click-through, always company
Watch list with reliability guarantees: due-time scheduling, failure backoff, at-least-once notification
Plans and replans its own task queue; deterministic moves and moods cost zero tokens
Remembers your relationship — streaks, busiest days, milestones celebrated exactly once
Quiet by design: notifications merge, silent mode holds them, meetings are respected
The autonomous core is fully in-process — no second app, no extra runtime
